increment: Validated signed main-order capacity snapshots and explicit directional reference panel; percentage order integration remains incomplete
prd_sections: 3.2 step3: independent directional capacity, cost and validation
3.4: zero-percent slider and blank initial input (slider still outstanding)
reference_note: Previously cached anonymous official documents and website bundles inspected locally; no new remote fetch asserted in this increment.
implemented: Strict immutable account mapping retains zero-quantity position configuration and order margin. Required fields, collateral units, signed quantity/notional consistency, duplicates and exact JSON numbers are validated at the data boundary.

Single-asset cross budget uses selected margin-asset available balance. Isolated budget is min(asset available, cross wallet minus cross maintenance and isolated pending-order margin); zero-quantity reservations count.

Multi-asset cross budget: [sum min((crossWallet+crossPnl)*bidRate,(crossWallet+crossPnl)*askRate) - sum initialMargin*askRate] / target askRate. Exact Rational division; no partial sums or invented rates. Actual isolated exposure is rejected in multi mode.

Fresh account configuration and selected position quantity/entry/margin/leverage/units are compared to original order context. Personal max is bounded by leverage bracket and account maxNotional; contract cap remains separate.

Pending ordinary fixed LIMIT reservation uses remaining quantity, with reduce-only/close/hedge-closing legs excluded. Independently calculated reservation is checked against account order margin with at most one last-place reporting quantum (max(reported scale,8)). This tolerance is an implementation choice, not verified exchange parity.

Explicit repository read requests at most five independent EOA signatures. Mode/account/unknown pending failures stop early. Each signed request retains exact bytes/nonces and checks identity and the original 30-second deadline after prompting and before sending.

Provider is read-free on watch; shared order lease excludes settings, unknown operations and recovery. Auth/symbol/context/stale changes invalidate responses and release read leases. Cancel cannot overwrite newer results or release a newer operation token.
Expected wallet app switches during an active order-lease read retain the original deadline; idle backgrounding still invalidates the live context.

Website-reference prices use exact decimals: market buy=floor((ask or Mark)*1.0005, declared pricePrecision); market sell=bid or Mark; limit buy=entered; limit sell=max(bid,Mark,entered). Market loss uses assumption, limit loss uses entered. pricePrecision is not tick size; absence is not inferred from tick.

MainOrderCapacityPanel is connected to the production LiveOrderForm for opening flows. Explicit read/cancel, current snapshot timestamp, separate base maxima, side-specific manual quantity/notional/cost, known-zero versus unknown, safe failure and stale placeholders; EN/ZH and responsive layouts. Editing input never requests a signature or overwrites input.

Panel validates entry filters only; opposite-side attached exits resolved for the selected direction are not presented as a newly valid strategy. Existing full selected-draft validation and signing remain in the original submit flow.
boundaries: Panel values are references only. It does not bind a submission, set percentage quantities, cap spending, guarantee fill/acceptance, or estimate liquidation.

Untriggered conditional, pending MARKET, moving BBO/compound peg opening reservations lack a verified reserved-notional contract. These return unknown, never zero. New moving-peg order-price assumptions are likewise unavailable.
Negative free budget is clamped to zero for capacity arithmetic; this does not prove exchange acceptance for negative equity. No future released margin, rebates or future fills are credited.

Account and orders are separate signed responses, not an atomic exchange snapshot; scope/configuration/expiry and independent margin corroboration detect inconsistencies without guaranteeing atomicity.

pricePrecision is optional for backward-compatible rule mapping, but a market-buy assumption requires it. Website formulas are current-cost references for conditional/trailing entries, not predictions of eventual trigger execution.
Existing manual-order submission and confirmation still use their existing checks. The new panel is not their pre-confirmation or post-wallet capacity guard.
No real signature/private/funds/chat request, address-bearing RPC, device tool, APK install or external publish was performed. iOS build unavailable on Linux.
remaining_required_work: Initial 0-percent main slider with blank quantities; independently scaled buy/sell amounts and maximum-based selections bound to input.
Market event/price and lifecycle invalidation/recomputation for a full sizing workflow, including reproducible price assumptions and margins.
Fresh same-side capacity check on click, frozen same-side/type/quantity review, after-wallet checks and accepted/unknown-result input handling.
Post-trade liquidation estimates across supported margin/position/asset modes.
Verified reservation and pricing contract for conditional/market/moving-peg pending orders; retain these as explicit functional gaps.
Full strategy management, Chase recovery, cross-product Portfolio and Swap remain outside this unfinished increment. Only historical statistics/Summary/TWAP are user-deferred.
